descriptions.default: Two women kneel side by side, each with her name sign on her head: Nephthys (a basket on a house) and Isis (a throne).

A tall long-haired woman bends forward, one hand on the back of a figure lying face down with its head raised; a scarab beetle sits beneath her. Layer named 'nut?'. Who she is (Nut?) and who lies under her hand is not certain.
A god sits on a block throne, wearing a tall crown with plumes and holding a was-sceptre. Probably Osiris (the crown), though he holds a was-sceptre, not crook and flail.
A tall offering stand with a round loaf on a dish and a lotus flower on top.
A man in a long kilt stands facing left, both hands raised in praise.
The jackal-headed god Anubis stands facing left, arms at his sides.
A man in a long kilt carries a chest with a curved lid, holding it up on one raised hand.
Two women stand facing right, each raising a hand: Nephthys (a basket on a house on her head) and Isis (a throne), who holds an ankh.
Two baboons stand upright facing right, forepaws raised in praise toward the boat.
A boat on the water. In the middle a god crouches wrapped in a cloak, a sun disc on horns on his head and a sceptre in his hand; before him a stand with a lotus flower; steering oars at the stern.
Two baboons stand upright facing left, forepaws raised in praise toward the boat.
Two women stand facing left, each raising one hand and holding an ankh: Isis (a throne on her head) and Nephthys (a basket on a house).
Two baboons squat on their haunches facing right, hands on their knees.

A boat on the water carries a crouching god with a scarab beetle for a head and wide horns; a stand with a lotus flower before him, and a damaged sign at the prow. The sign at the prow is broken and could not be made out.
The hieroglyphic text above the scenes of plate IX, with remnants of signs.
A man kneels on his heels facing left, both hands raised in praise toward the boat.
Two baboons squat on their haunches facing left, hands on their knees. Read as baboons (they match the seated baboons of plate X); the heads could also be read as lions'.
A falcon with a flail at its back perches on a tall standard.
A long-eared cat sits upright and holds down the head of a long wavy snake with its paw: Ra as the great cat of Heliopolis, cutting up Apep.
A tall leafy tree beside the cat: the persea tree of Heliopolis.
A small figure sits on the ground with one knee drawn up. Badly drawn or damaged; the head may be a falcon's.
Two gods with long wigs and beards sit on block thrones, facing right.
Two ribbed bowls side by side, with signs set on and above them: a jar, a stand, a loaf and a long rope-like sign, under a band of water ripples and a domed sign.
A wrapped, bearded god stands facing left beneath a pair of wedjat eyes.

god_with_emblem.name: God with a sign on his head

descriptions.default: A bearded god stands facing left, a tall curled sign on his head. The sign on his head could not be identified.
A mummy-shaped figure with a jackal's head, facing right: Duamutef, a son of Horus.
A mummy-shaped figure with a human head in a heavy wig, facing right: Imsety, a son of Horus. The face is mostly lost; human by elimination (the other three heads are jackal, baboon and falcon).
A tall shrine with ribbed sides and a vaulted roof, a falcon perched on top, between the sons of Horus.
A mummy-shaped figure with a baboon's head, facing left: Hapy, a son of Horus.
A mummy-shaped figure with a falcon's head, facing left: Qebehsenuef, a son of Horus.

A cow lies on a shrine, a sun disc with two plumes on her head and a flail on her back: Mehet-weret, the great cow of the sky. Layer named 'Ram shrine'; the crown sits on wavy ram-like horns, but the body is a cow's.
The hieroglyphic text above the scenes of plate VIII, with remnants of signs.
A man stands facing left, one hand raised in praise, the other holding up a small bowl.
The wedjat eye, the Eye of Horus, rests on a shrine.
A figure sits with one knee drawn up; it has an animal's head with a snout, in a heavy wig. The animal is unclear (a dog or a baboon?).
A tall shrine with a rearing snake inside and three blades standing on its roof.
Two women kneel facing left, each with a hand at her face in mourning; small signs lie on the ground before them.
A kite with the Nephthys sign (a basket on a house) on its head, at the head of the bier: Nephthys mourning the dead.
The mummy lies on a lion-shaped bier, the lion's head at one end and its tail curling up at the other; four looped signs below.
A kite with the Isis sign (a throne) on its head stands on a low base at the foot of the bier: Isis mourning the dead.
A crested heron facing left: the Benu, the bird of renewal. A sliver of the Isis kite's tail is in this layer at its left edge.
A lion sits upright facing left, back to back with the other across the horizon: Aker, yesterday and tomorrow.
The horizon sign: the sun disc rising between two hills, between the two lions.
The hieroglyphic text above the scenes of plate VII, with remnants of signs.
A lion sits upright facing right, back to back with the other across the horizon: Aker, yesterday and tomorrow.

boat_with_crew.name: Boat with a crew of gods

descriptions.default: A long boat on the water with six gods standing in it holding spears, three on each side of a stand where a crowned animal lies under a sun disc. The animal on the stand could not be identified.
A man holds up a lotus flower in one hand and a bunch of flowers in the other; a tall pointed pole stands beside him. What the pointed pole is could not be made out.
A man stands facing left, both hands raised in praise.
A bird with a human head, a long wig and a curled beard stands on a low base: the ba, the soul of the dead.
A falcon stands on a perch with a curved rest.
Under a canopy the deceased sits on a chair, a staff in hand, before a game board on a stand: playing senet, the game that decides the passage.
A man in a long robe with a sash stands facing left, a staff in his hand: the deceased. Layer named 'Standing deity', but he is a man, not a god.
